reason: The cited passages support Y-Hf co-doping for oxidation resistance in EHEA coatings, but provide no evidence on mechanical properties, irradiation stability, or bulk RHEAs. The hypothesis overstates the evidence by claiming mechanical improvement and irradiation stability without support.
